notes.title: Find All - Remaster!
notes.content: In honor of the studio's 4th, we decided to release an update of our first game Find All - Remaster! We have redrawn the map and re-hidden items, but the atmosphere has remained the same! The game has new citizens, item selection cards, hint, improved settings and new atmospheric music. And also appeared DLC for 250 items with a new system of finding cats and coloring book, which many people loved. Explore the cozy streets of the old town, find different items and paint black - white locations with colored inks. Update and play!

notes.title: FIND ALL: Bunker - Released!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543720/FIND_ALL_Bunker/?curator_clanid=40622694
 The continued series of Find All: Bunker games has been released. Explore the underground bunker and the surface of the earth in anticipation of a nuclear explosion, finding various objects and paint the black and white picture with colored paints. 
 Also during the release of the game will be released 2 add-ons, in one of which, at the numerous requests of our players we have created coloring.
 Extra Level is a large, interesting map for 270 items with an underground bunker and what is left on the surface of the earth after the nuclear explosion. 
 Coloring Book. Just print and color the underground bunker before and after the nuclear explosion.

notes.title: FIND ALL 2: Middle Ages
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571956/34bd718358aaa573d6636ebc07d8049e629f5e3d.png[/img]

We invite you to plunge into the fascinating world of the Middle Ages to find there all the hidden cute cats, dogs, birds and many more different objects. Finding lost items, you will return beautiful colorful colors to the world. Everything is done in a cute hand-drawn style.
We have prepared for you an exciting mini-game in the style of "Hit the mole" with cute knight cats, ninja pandas and many more different cute animals with their own unique features. In search of hidden objects, you will find a mysterious treasure map and go to search for treasure on the lost island. To get to the treasure, you will need to solve interesting puzzles and get priceless riches, fame and achievements for this.

Features of the game:
- Over 500 different items to find
- Mini game in the style of "Hit the mole" with a world rating
- Puzzles
- Treasure search
- Coloring levels
- 2.5D effect

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1722520/FIND_ALL_2_Middle_Ages
